Description: Track-switches experiment topology. Single 4-port multi-state switch at ts-spur-tip-1 (true 3-way: 1 enter + 3 diverging routes from the same origin). Rendered with custom geometry (vanilla can't handle 4-port nodes natively).

EastReference.Comment: Defines what 'east' means for relative-direction placements: the horizontal direction from FromNode toward ToNode. azimuthDeg=0 means along east; negative=left of east; positive=right of east.

Nodes.Comment: TRUE 3-WAY origin. 4 connected segments: ts-spur-1 (enter) + 3 outgoing routes. Marked MultiStateSwitch so our renderer takes over from vanilla.
Route 0 (left) end. Diverges 9deg further left than the spur axis.
Route 1 (middle / through) end. Continues the spur axis.
Route 2 (right) end. Diverges 9deg right of the spur axis (back toward east).

Segments.Comment: Approach spur. Anchor (Nwe2) becomes a 3-port vanilla switch as a side effect.
Route 0: leftmost diverging route off the 3-way.
Route 1: middle / through route off the 3-way.
Route 2: rightmost diverging route off the 3-way.
